headline: Every YouTube creator can now upload custom Shorts thumbnails
dek: YouTube has opened custom thumbnails for Shorts to all creators, on mobile or desktop, during upload or after publishing, through the Shorts flow in YouTube Studio. The option reached YouTube Partner Program members first in June. Creators can still pick a suggested frame from the video instead.
why: Shorts show up in search and on channel pages, and until now a small business channel was stuck with whatever frame YouTube picked. A readable cover gives each video a better chance of being tapped. Social Media Today did not say whether every region has the option yet.
doThis: Make one simple thumbnail template with your logo and the customer question in large text, use it on your next five Shorts, and compare their views with your earlier ones.
